nodes.label: Durable Object per Room Pool with SQLite and revision requestId gate
nodes.rationale: In-memory only loses state on hibernation causing overfill and double processing; single global object loses parallelism and isolation; D1-only loses per-room consistency and low-latency WS; single DO creates hotspot. Hence per-room serialized consistency with SQLite plus D1 for shared search and rating history.
nodes.norm_label: durable object per room pool with sqlite and revision requestid gate

nodes.label: Revision monotonic events with resume token and bounded history
nodes.rationale: Immediate-exit on disconnect loses readiness and host; unconditional apply corrupts state via gaps and duplicates; snapshot-only cannot efficiently restore; client-time-only allows spoofing; unbounded history exhausts SQLite. Hence apply-next-only with dedupe, resync on gap, bounded history with snapshot fallback, grace period, and bound resume token.
nodes.norm_label: revision monotonic events with resume token and bounded history
